You don't need an account to create or use a vault, and the hosted service never receives the vault itself. It's still early software and the independent security review isn't finished yet, so I am mainly interested in feedback, testing, and people looking through the code. (Linux support is yet to be released on v0.1.2, but currently is in the works.) Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49483038 Points: 39 # Comments: 42 Fuente: Hacker News - Portada.
